mentions.name: Jaskiniowy Kataster Tatr Zachodnich
mentions.description: An open cave registry for the Western Tatra Mountains that brings together cave survey data, entrance locations, maps, and terrain models into a single open spatial dataset, published with an interactive 3D model and open-source repository.
mentions.audience: People interested in cave mapping, GIS, open scientific datasets, or underground worlds in general
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on an open cave registry for the Western Tatra Mountains.

The Tatras may look solid from the outside, but our mountains are hollow inside - and there is still a lot to discover. The project brings together cave survey data, entrances, maps, and terrain models into one open spatial dataset.
